note: Wikimedia Commons, “Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 11121 Прокл и Иларий.png”; artist as recorded there: Unknown author — fetched 14 October 2026; the file is 809px wide. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Russian Menaion Reader plate «11121»: church-month 11 = July, day 12, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate's title is «Прокл и Иларий» — Proclus and Hilary — and this folder is literally that Hilary: its slug and display name are «Hilary, companion of Proclus» and its Russian form «Иларий Калиптский», the nephew martyred with Proclus at Callipolis. A two-figure plate naming both, so the hero shows the pair the folder is half of. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
